name: Zombie Brute (PFS 1-18) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-18: Lodge of the Living God

generalAbilities.name: Slow
generalAbilities.description: A zombie is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rotting Aura
defensiveAbilities.description:
10 feet. The zombie emits an aura of rot and disease that causes wounds to fester and turn sour.

Any living creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of the zombie and is not at full Hit Points takes 1d6 Untyped Damage damage as its wounds fester. Creatures that take a critical hit from the zombie also take this damage immediately.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Push 5 feet
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Push in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Shove the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty. If Improved Push lists a distance, change the distance the creature is pushed on a success to that distance.
